name: Exp_Stalin
summary: This EA trades based on the custom 'Stalin' indicator, which combines fast/slow moving averages with RSI to generate momentum signals. It opens buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals, with optional position closing on opposite signals. The EA uses the TradeAlgorithms library for position management and supports multiple money management modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Stalin'指标进行交易，该指标结合快慢均线和RSI生成动量信号。在向上动量信号时开多仓，在向下动量信号时开空仓，并可选择在反向信号时平仓。EA使用TradeAlgorithms库进行仓位管理，支持多种资金管理模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于自定义Stalin指标，该指标融合了快速均线(Fast=14)、慢速均线(Slow=21)和RSI(周期17)三种技术分析工具，形成复合动量信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）出现非零非空值时触发买入开仓信号，当指标缓冲区0（DnValue）出现非零非空值时触发卖出开仓信号。出场条件分为两种：一是通过止损/止盈参数设定固定点数退出(StopLoss=1000, TakeProfit=2000)，二是当检测到反向信号时平仓（通过回溯历史柱确认反向信号的存在性）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险敞口比例，默认0.1。策略还包含Confirm和Flat参数用于信号确认和横盘过滤，但默认值均为0表示未启用。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the custom Stalin indicator, which integrates three technical analysis tools: a fast moving average (Fast=14), a slow moving average (Slow=21), and RSI (period 17) to form composite momentum signals. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero non-empty value, a buy signal is triggered; when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces a non-zero non-empty value, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions come in two forms: fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) exits, and opposite signal-based exits where the EA looks back through historical bars to confirm the presence of a contrary signal before closing positions. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk exposure of 0.1. The strategy also includes Confirm and Flat parameters for signal confirmation and flat market filtering, though both default to 0 (disabled).

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size, meaning per MMMode

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：自由保证金/余额/扣损自由保证金/扣损余额/固定手数

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓(反向信号)
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓(反向信号)
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号计算使用的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，结合均线和RSI形成多维度动量判断，减少单一指标误判
提供五种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易者的风险偏好和账户规模
支持独立的买入/卖出开仓和平仓控制，可灵活配置为只开仓不反向平仓或反向平仓模式
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈参数明确，默认2:1的盈亏比（1000:2000）符合正期望值交易原则
pros_en: Clear strategy logic combining moving averages and RSI for multi-dimensional momentum judgment, reducing single-indicator false signals
Five money management modes providing flexibility for different risk preferences and account sizes
Independent buy/sell open and close controls allow flexible configuration from open-only to full reverse-signal closing mode
IsNewBar mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Explicit stop loss and take profit with a default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio (1000:2000) aligning with positive expectancy trading
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标Stalin和TradeAlgorithms库，缺乏独立性和可移植性
反向信号平仓逻辑存在缺陷：当同时启用买卖开仓和平仓时，反向平仓需要遍历历史柱寻找信号，可能导致延迟平仓或逻辑混乱
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在点差较大或低流动性时段可能产生不利成交
Confirm和Flat参数默认为0等于未启用，缺少信号确认和横盘过滤机制
代码中大量乱码注释（编码问题），严重影响代码可读性和可维护性
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator Stalin and TradeAlgorithms library, lacking independence and portability

Reverse signal closing logic has flaws: when both buy/sell open and close are enabled, reverse closing requires iterating through historical bars for signals, potentially causing delayed or confused exits
No spread filter or trading session filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Confirm and Flat parameters default to 0 effectively disabling signal confirmation and flat market filtering mechanisms
Extensive garbled comments (encoding issues) severely impact code readability and maintainability
improvements: 增加点差过滤器，当当前点差超过阈值时暂停交易，避免高成本成交
启用Confirm参数并提供合理的默认值（如1-3柱），增加信号确认机制减少假信号
增加交易时段过滤，避免在低流动性时段交易
优化反向平仓逻辑，避免通过遍历历史柱的方式确认反向信号，改为直接使用最近的信号状态判断
修复源代码编码问题，将乱码注释替换为正确的UTF-8编码或英文注释
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause trading when the current spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding high-cost fills
Enable the Confirm parameter with a reasonable default value (1-3 bars) to add signal confirmation and reduce false signals
Add trading session filtering to avoid trading during low-liquidity periods
Optimize the reverse closing logic by avoiding historical bar iteration for confirming opposite signals, instead using the most recent signal state directly
Fix source code encoding issues by replacing garbled comments with proper UTF-8 encoded or English comments

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生滑点损失
反向信号平仓逻辑需要遍历历史柱，在数据不足时可能导致Recount=true频繁触发，影响执行效率
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
依赖外部库和自定义指标，若依赖组件缺失或更新可能造成运行失败
risk_points_en: No spread filter, potential slippage losses in high-spread environments
Reverse signal closing logic requires iterating historical bars, Recount=true may be frequently triggered when data is insufficient, affecting execution efficiency
No existing position check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Dependency on external library and custom indicator, runtime failures possible if dependencies are missing or updated
